annotation_provenance: Developer-authored proxy annotations made before either reviewer arm; no independent human adjudication, no M51 natural-generation claim, and no scored model calls for this dataset.
claim_boundary: Fixed, hand-authored two-candidate packets test only paired M46 decision-interface discrimination under shared deterministic guards. They do not authorize product delivery, bypass, human usefulness, or a full latency claim.
gold_policy: The selected packet is valid only when content_valid, japanese_surface_valid, and actor_valid are all true. Invalid packets have one preregistered primary failed axis; all ten scored packets must pass the common deterministic guard and isolated M39 exact-surface check. Guard controls are never sent to either reviewer.
